snapshot.title: Time Jump: 11:00 AM — Control Network Isolation Confirmed

fields.narration: Facilitator: All hands, this is a time jump. It is now 11:00 AM. The team has initiated manual operations and must now verify system integrity. The lab remains offline, the AMI map is still inaccessible, and the Public Information Officer has no access to the digital advisory templates. The Director of Water Operations has authorized manual control of the plant, but the SCADA / IT Security Manager has not yet confirmed that the control network is fully isolated from the compromised business network.
worldState: The control network is now confirmed isolated from the business network via firewall rule FW-R-17, which has been disabled and locked by the SCADA / IT Security Manager.
The jump host MBW-JUMP-01 has been physically disconnected and is no longer accessible.
The SCADA / IT Security Manager has confirmed that no unauthorized sessions are active on MBW-EWS-01 or MBW-SCADA-SRV01.
The control network is operating in manual mode with continuous operator oversight. No remote access is permitted until the integrity of the backup system (MBW-BKP-01) is validated.
The lab has not resumed operations; paper logs are in use for water quality data.
The Public Information Officer has been directed to use the cyber holding statement (MDWS-PCP-2026, Section 10) for all public messaging until further notice.
The City Manager has been updated and has authorized the use of the holding statement for media inquiries.
fields.facilitatorNote: This jump confirms isolation of the control network. The SCADA / IT Security Manager must now validate the integrity of the backup server (MBW-BKP-01) and ensure no residual malware persists in the DMZ. Watch for attempts to restore from compromised backups.
